nodes.label: Assumption: Runway calculations assume positive monthly net cash burn that stays constant o…
nodes.description: Runway calculations assume positive monthly net cash burn that stays constant over the period being considered.

nodes.label: Assumption: The angel option calculates runway conditional on the intended angel amount bei…
nodes.description: The angel option calculates runway conditional on the intended angel amount being received before cash runs out; switching the route on does not predict that funding will arrive.

nodes.label: Assumption: The conditional bridge calculation deducts the additional cash overhead once an…
nodes.description: The conditional bridge calculation deducts the additional cash overhead once and assumes the remaining proceeds are available for operating expenses.

nodes.label: Assumption: The angel route supplements rather than replaces cold emails and efforts to fin…
nodes.description: The angel route supplements rather than replaces cold emails and efforts to find warm connections.

nodes.label: Condition: Angel proceeds must become available before existing cash runs out for the calc…
nodes.description: Angel proceeds must become available before existing cash runs out for the calculated extra runway to prevent a cash shortfall.

nodes.label: Left out: The probability and timing of receiving funding through investment firms, cold …
nodes.description: The probability and timing of receiving funding through investment firms, cold emails, warm connections or angels are not calculated. Why: The brief gives no pipeline stage, investor commitments or conversion evidence from which to estimate route-specific funding outcomes responsibly.

nodes.label: Left out: The firms' £1–2 million deal range and mostly UK location are retained as targe…
nodes.description: The firms' £1–2 million deal range and mostly UK location are retained as targeting context, not treated as a promised funding amount or a success-rate adjustment. Why: A firm's usual deal size does not establish the amount this business seeks or the likelihood of securing it.

nodes.label: Left out: Founder time, distraction, dilution and future fundraising complications are no…
nodes.description: Founder time, distraction, dilution and future fundraising complications are not included in the cash-overhead calculation. Why: The brief does not specify which kinds of overhead matter or how they should be weighed against extra runway.

nodes.label: Left out: Cash spent on an angel raise that fails, and the timing of fees before funding …
nodes.description: Cash spent on an angel raise that fails, and the timing of fees before funding arrives, are not modelled. Why: The conditional runway calculation covers a successful bridge rather than a dated cash-flow forecast or a failed-raise scenario.

nodes.label: Left out: Achievement of the funding objective within two months is not yet assessed.
nodes.description: Achievement of the funding objective within two months is not yet assessed. Why: The amount that would count as successful funding has not been stated, and funding receipt timing is not yet modelled.
